definitions.explanation: Efforts and projects aimed at revitalizing a village or rural area, often through tourism, local products, events, or community initiatives. A significant topic in modern Japan as rural depopulation continues.

examples.japanese: {村|むら}おこし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I participated in a village revitalization event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{特産品|とくさんひん}→特産品：13483_tokusanhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かした→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧{村|むら}おこし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Village revitalization using local specialties is getting attention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧{村|むら}おこし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are areas where young people are taking the lead in village revitalization efforts.

notes:
⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧ means 'village,' and おこし comes from ⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to raise up, to start). {村|むら}おこし describes grassroots or government-supported efforts to breathe new life into declining rural communities. It is a widely discussed social topic in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {村|むら}おこし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ (to work on village revitalization)
- {村|むら}おこし⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧ (village revitalization event)
- {村|むら}おこし⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧ (village revitalization project)
- {村|むら}おこし⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (village revitalization movement)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Rural depopulation (⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧) is a serious issue in Japan, with young people moving to cities and leaving villages with aging populations. {村|むら}おこし projects often involve promoting local tourism, developing regional brands, or hosting festivals to attract visitors and new residents.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{町|まち}おこし→町おこし：13570_machiokoshi⟧ — town revitalization (same concept applied to towns)
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{活性化|かっせいか}→活性化：07563_kasseika⟧ — regional revitalization (more formal, broader term)
- ⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧ — depopulation (the problem that village revitalization aims to address)
